title: MCP vs API Calls: Which Should You Use for Python LLM Apps?
description: MCP vs API calls: build one Python tool, integrate it both ways, and compare. Learn what each approach costs and when an MCP server pays for itself.
summary: Anthropic open-sourced the Model Context Protocol (MCP) in November 2024 to fix a scaling problem: every new tool a model reached for needed its own integration, built on direct API calls. Building that integration today involves a decision usually framed as MCP vs API calls.
takeaways: ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, and Microsoft Copilot had all added support, and Anthropic had donated the protocol to the Linux Foundation.

Here’s a quick reference to help you choose the right approach: Use Case Pick MCP Pick Direct API Calls You’ll reuse the same tools across several apps or model providers ✅ — You’re shipping one app and want zero extra infrastructure — ✅ The comparison sections below give the reasoning behind each row.
